# United Kingdom Vehicle Bill of Sale

> A bill of sale / sales receipt for a **private** vehicle sale in the United Kingdom, following the GOV.UK "Buy a vehicle" and "Sell, scrap or transfer a vehicle" journeys. One continuous single-page wizard records the sale, the seller and buyer, the vehicle, the checks, the price and payment, the condition terms, the DVLA steps, and both signatures.
